db-schema.description: Design and provision the Supabase PostgreSQL schema. Create tables for SKUs (products), Inventory Levels (inventory), Competitor Pricing Feeds (competitor_prices), Safety Guardrails (pricing_guardrails), Pricing Policy Logs (pricing_policy_logs), and Pricing Decisions Log (pricing_decisions) to track EBITDA lift for outcome-based billing. Include views such as ebitda_lift_summary. Expected output files: db/schema.sql or supabase/migrations/20260401000000_schema.sql, lib/db/types.ts
db-schema.result_summary: Successfully designed and provisioned PostgreSQL schema and TypeScript definitions. Created supabase/migrations/20260401000000_schema.sql and db/schema.sql covering products, inventory, competitor_prices, pricing_guardrails, pricing_decisions, sales_events, pricing_policy_logs, vendor_contracts, market_intel, sku_pricing_state, pricing_performance_metrics, ebitda_lift_summary view, and calculate_ebitda_lift stored procedure. Created comprehensive TypeScript types in lib/db/types.ts.

backend-api-setup.description: Initialize Next.js App Router project setup and integrate the @google/genai (>=2.3.0) SDK. Set up GoogleGenAI client configuration in lib/genai.ts, Orchestrator Agent initialization in lib/agents/orchestrator.ts using gemini-3.7-flash, and core API evaluation route app/api/pricing/evaluate/route.ts. Expected output files: lib/genai.ts, lib/agents/orchestrator.ts, app/api/pricing/evaluate/route.ts, package.json
backend-api-setup.result_summary: Initialized Next.js App Router setup with package.json, configured GoogleGenAI client with 2026 Interactions & Agents API in lib/genai.ts, implemented Orchestrator Agent with gemini-3.7-flash in lib/agents/orchestrator.ts, and implemented evaluation API route in app/api/pricing/evaluate/route.ts.

mas-implementation.description: Implement the specialized agents via client.interactions.create / client.agents.create: ERP Inventory Agent with function calling tools (get_inventory_status), Trade Promotion Agent (get_map_constraints), and core Dynamic Pricing Agent (get_market_data) simulating DRL/MDP logic R_t = alpha*Margin + (1-alpha)*Volume - beta*Churn. Build orchestration flow in app/api/price-optimizer/route.ts. Expected output files: lib/agents/tools.ts, lib/agents/definitions.ts, app/api/price-optimizer/route.ts
mas-implementation.result_summary: Implemented Multi-Agent System (MAS) with ERP Inventory Agent, Trade Promotion Agent, and Dynamic Pricing Agent in lib/agents/definitions.ts. Created Supabase function-calling tools in lib/agents/tools.ts (get_inventory_status, get_map_constraints, get_market_data). Orchestrated sequential multi-agent execution pipeline in app/api/price-optimizer/route.ts with DRL reward function optimization and audit snapshotting.

guardrails-safety.description: Develop Policy-as-Code safety guardrails layer (lib/pricing/guardrails.ts). Enforce mathematical hard bounds (±15% price delta limit), semantic anti-price-gouging safety checks using gemini-3.7-flash structured output, and persistent logging to Supabase pricing_policy_logs table. Expose API endpoint app/api/pricing/update/route.ts. Expected output files: lib/pricing/guardrails.ts, app/api/pricing/update/route.ts
guardrails-safety.result_summary: Developed Policy-as-Code safety guardrails in lib/pricing/guardrails.ts with deterministic hard bounds (±15%), semantic anti-gouging detection via gemini-3.7-flash structured JSON output, and persistent Supabase audit logging. Created API route app/api/pricing/update/route.ts for intercepted price updates.

frontend-dashboard.description: Build the commercialization dashboard in Next.js App Router (app/page.tsx). Create CommercializationMetrics React Server Component (calculating EBITDA lift & performance fee), StateSpaceMonitor client component with Supabase Realtime streaming, and AgentReasoning explainable AI panel using gemini-3.7-flash Interactions API. Expected output files: app/page.tsx, components/dashboard/CommercializationMetrics.tsx, components/dashboard/StateSpaceMonitor.tsx, components/dashboard/AgentReasoning.tsx
frontend-dashboard.result_summary: Built commercialization dashboard in app/page.tsx with CommercializationMetrics RSC (calculating EBITDA lift, DRL policy reward, and 20% value-based fee), StateSpaceMonitor client component (tracking live S_t state space and MAS optimization triggers), and AgentReasoning explainable AI panel utilizing gemini-3.7-flash and Google GenAI Interactions API.
